incrementLock(uint256,uint256).notice: PLEASE BE AWARE THIS FUNCTION CONTAINS NO OWNER CHECK. ANYONE CAN LOCK THEIR LPS INTO SOMEONE ELSES LOCK, BASICALLY GIVING THEM THEIR LP TOKENS. The use here is a CONTRACT which is not the owner of a lock can increment locks periodically (for example with fees) on behalf of the owner. This works well with taxing tokens. Increase the amount of tokens per a specific lock, this is preferable to creating a new lock, less fees, and faster loading on our live block explorer.

Ethereum Uniswap V2 LP locker at 0x59d7d55ddc58494fbbbca29904f108ece82ac7fb only, exact-match Sourcify full source/ABI; nonproxy UniswapV2Locker, no implementation indirection. UNCX/Unicrypt is one lineage. Other versions, chains, token vesting and farms are not admitted.

The official contract table displays this exact address but its explorer hyperlink points to a different historical address; admission uses the displayed exact contract address and its own verified source, not that hyperlink. Current primary liquidity-locking page and availability table support ongoing Ethereum V2 locking.

Amounts are LP-token base units, timestamps are Unix seconds and must be below 10000000000. lockLPToken does not enforce a future timestamp or a nonzero beneficiary; caller must choose both correctly. It checks the pool token0/token1 pair against the configured Uniswap factory and country validity.

lockLPToken pulls only msg.sender LPs, deducts current proportional fee and credits the specified initial withdrawer in the internal financial ledger. Naming a third party makes that party the withdrawal owner, not the payer. Existing ERC20 allowances may be required; no approve, permit, signing, ownership transfer or authority-management method is admitted.

Non-whitelisted lockLPToken with _fee_in_eth=true requires exact current native fee, adjusted for referral; splitLock always requires exact current native fee. Other lockLPToken fee mode pulls/burns configured secondary fee tokens; send zero native value in that mode because it has no refund path. Whitelisted lock creation refunds accidental native value. Nonpayable methods require zero native value.

Fees, fee recipients, referral eligibility/token, fee whitelist and migrator are owner-configurable. Percentage and referral calculations use integer floor division with denominator 1000. Token/referral burn and transfer dependencies may revert; fee settings may make execution uneconomic or unavailable. No exhaustive dependency runtime/backing attestation is claimed.

incrementLock deliberately has no owner check: it pulls caller funds and gifts net LP tokens to the chosen existing lock owner without changing its unlock date. relock requires caller ownership and strictly extends unlock time, deducting another LP fee. splitLock preserves beneficiary and unlock date while splitting its balance, with fixed native fee.

withdraw requires recorded owner==msg.sender, positive amount and unlockDate strictly less than block.timestamp; it decrements only the internal remaining lock balance then transfers LPs to caller. Solidity underflow rejects excess withdrawals. No asset swaps, AMM liquidity removal, early unlock, migrations or ownership transfer are included.
